This plot is rented, but maize here in the North East needs fertilizer if I want a good harvest — the soil is tired and the rains are short. I will buy a bit of NPK and urea, and also put some manure from our goats because fertilizer alone is expensive. I'll use improved maize seed since I bought some from the agro-dealer last year and it did better. I won't irrigate — we depend on the rains — and I'll do most of the weeding myself, but with 4.9 hectares across all our plots I will need to hire a few hands for planting and weeding this one.
